formal_name: Phase 5.6B R4 Administrative Broker Authority Simplification R1

overrides_only: the requirement that bootstrap execute specifically as DESKTOP-HLIAI3U\Phase56bAdmin
the requirement that bootstrap provenance be established by one named administrator account
FURTHER_AUTHORITY_REQUIRED when the only missing fact is named-administrator provenance
does_not_override: service identity, service SID, ACL, service-DACL, IPC, validation, denial, authority-custody, rollback, recovery, evidence, review, or preservation gates

trusted_administrative_execution.rule: Bootstrap operations must execute under trusted administrative authority and resulting protected guest state must be independently verified.
allowed: another explicitly approved local administrator context
powershell_direct_may: configure service SID, service DACL, filesystem ownership, and ACLs
place protected files and configure local registry/service state
perform rollback, recovery, administrative inspection, and evidence collection

mandatory_security_properties: phase56b remains non-administrative and outside Administrators
broker service uses the intended protected service identity and correctly configured service SID
phase56b cannot modify broker binaries, configuration, or authority material
phase56b cannot modify governed Build038 or governed toolchain inputs where qualification depends on them
service DACL denies phase56b reconfiguration, deletion, and security-descriptor modification
authenticated local IPC accepts authorized requests and rejects unauthorized, malformed, stale, replayed, concurrent-invalid, and substituted requests
broker validates operation, caller, canonical paths, governed outputs, tool and input identity, anti-replay state, and expected execution topology before privileged use
protected authority material and administrator credentials remain inaccessible to phase56b
bootstrap denial checks run in the non-administrator consumer context
rollback and recovery restore a known clean state
in_scope_threats: accidental exposure of protected broker material
out_of_scope_controls: certificate-based local IPC unless independently required by the implementation
separate administrator login solely to prove account provenance
controls whose only threat is the trusted machine owner or administrator
another governance layer solely recording who ran bootstrap

review_a_product_security_fit.finding: Named-administrator provenance is unnecessary for the single-owner threat model; retained result-based gates still protect every concrete R4 broker property.

review_b_windows_implementation.finding: The successor retains service SID, protected ACL and service-DACL semantics, authenticated IPC, broker-side validation, consumer denial checks, protected authority custody, and rollback/recovery.

review_c_complexity_audit.finding: Enterprise-only provenance, PKI, domain, remote, multi-tenant, hostile-admin, vault, attestation, and redundant-governance requirements are excluded unless a later concrete in-scope property independently requires one.

car.action: Resolved terminal-status ambiguity by separating authority-simplification freeze readiness from future bootstrap readiness.
car.regression_rule: This artifact must never be interpreted as evidence that the broker bootstrap or Revision 4 qualification passed.

formal_freeze_proposal.commit_subject: Simplify Phase 5.6B R4 administrative broker authority
formal_freeze_proposal.annotation: Verify Phase 5.6B R4 Administrative Broker Authority Simplification Revision 1

next_step: Separately review and formally freeze this successor authority; only afterward execute the administrative broker bootstrap under trusted administrative authority with full result-based verification, then stop before Revision 4 qualification.
